text:
In my opinion, the most important thing for a young person is to travel while he is still student. When I was in the university in Izmir, I did not have much money, but I saved from my food money and I went to Prague with two friend. This experience change my life completely.

First reason is that travel teach you the things which book cannot teach. You must find the hotel by yourself, you must speak with people who do not understand your language, and you must solve the problem when the train is late. These are the skills that no exam can measure.

Second reason is about the tolerance. Before I travel, I think that my country's way is the only correct way. After I saw how the people live in other place, I understand that there are many correct ways. This is very important lesson for a young mind.

Some people say that the young person should first finish the education and after that travel. I do not agree with this idea, because when you finish the education you have the job and the family, and you cannot travel freely anymore. The time of the student is the only free time in the life.

For these reasons I believe strongly that every student must travel at least one time to a foreign country before he graduate.

To the customer service department,

I am writing to make a complaint about the service which I received in your branch last Saturday. I have been your customer since 9 years and never before I had such an experience.

I came to the branch at 10 o'clock in the morning for to change my address in the system. The employee told me that I must to bring the invoice of the electricity. I explained him that in my new house the invoice is not yet coming because we moved only two weeks ago. He answered me very rudely that this is not his problem and he must follow the rules.

After that I asked to speak with the manager. I waited 40 minutes standing, nobody offered me even a chair, and finally another employee said me that the manager is in the meeting and I should come tomorrow. This behaviour is not acceptable for a bank which says in the advertisement that the customer is in the center.

I am asking you to investigate this situation and to inform me what will be done. If I do not receive any answer in two weeks, I will be obliged to move my accounts to another bank.

Respectfully yours,
A. Yilmaz

The question of whether governments should invest more money in public transportation is widely discussed in recent years. In my view, such investment is not only necessary but also urgent, and I will explain my position in the following paragraphs.

Firstly, public transportation reduces the traffic congestion in the big cities. Istanbul, where I lived for six years, loses an enormous amount of working hours every day because millions of people sit alone in their private cars. Furthermore, the air pollution which comes from these cars damages the health of the children who live near the main roads.

Moreover, a good transportation system is a matter of equality. A person who cannot afford a car should still be able to reach a hospital, a university or a job interview in a reasonable time. Additionally, elderly citizens depend completely on buses and metros for their social life.

On the other hand, some people argue that the money should be spent on hospitals and schools instead. However, I believe this is a false comparison, because a hospital which nobody can reach is not useful for anybody.

In conclusion, investment in public transportation brings benefits to the economy, to the environment and to the social justice at the same time. Therefore, governments should treat it as a priority and not as a luxury.

text: Merhaba, 12 Ağustos'ta İstanbul'a geliyoruz ve otelinizde iki gece kalmak istiyoruz. Biz üç kişiyiz, eşim ve dokuz yaşındaki kızımla birlikte. Kızım için ilave yatak koyabilir misiniz? Ayrıca havalimanından otele transfer hizmetiniz var mı, varsa ücreti nedir? Bilgi verirseniz çok sevinirim. Saygılarımla.

Sayın Yetkili,

Müvekkilim adına, 17.06.2026 tarihinde tarafınıza iletilen ihtarnameye rağmen herhangi bir cevap alınamamış olması nedeniyle işbu yazıyı göndermek durumunda kalıyorum.

Müvekkilim, tarafınızla 03.02.2026 tarihinde imzalanan sözleşme kapsamında yükümlülüklerini eksiksiz olarak yerine getirmiştir. Sözleşmenin 7. maddesinde açıkça belirtildiği üzere, teslimatın en geç otuz gün içinde tamamlanması gerekmektedir. Ancak aradan dört ay geçmiş olmasına rağmen teslimat gerçekleşmemiştir.

Bu durum, müvekkilim açısından ciddi bir ticari zarara yol açmaktadır. Kendisi, söz konusu ürünleri kendi müşterilerine tedarik edeceğini taahhüt etmiş ve bu nedenle üçüncü kişilere karşı da sorumlu duruma düşmüştür.

Tarafınıza son kez bildiriyoruz ki, işbu yazının tebliğinden itibaren yedi gün içerisinde teslimatın yapılmaması veya ödenen bedelin iadesi hususunda somut bir adım atılmaması halinde, herhangi bir ihbara gerek kalmaksızın yasal yollara başvurulacaktır. Doğacak tüm yargılama giderleri ve vekalet ücreti tarafınıza ait olacaktır.

Gereğinin ivedilikle yapılmasını rica ederim.

Saygılarımla,
Av. Sait Yağcı

Kapadokya'da üç gece kaldık ve genel olarak memnun ayrıldık. Otelin konumu çok iyi, Göreme merkezine yürüyerek beş dakika sürüyor. Odamız mağara odaydı, biraz serindi ama battaniye istediğimizde hemen getirdiler.

Kahvaltı beklediğimizden daha zengindi. Özellikle köy peyniri ve ev yapımı reçeller çok güzeldi. Sadece kahve makinesi bozuktu ve üç gün boyunca tamir edilmedi, bu biraz can sıkıcıydı.

Personel gerçekten ilgili. Resepsiyondaki genç arkadaş balon turu için bize yardımcı oldu ve daha uygun bir firma buldu. Akşam terasta çay ikram ettiler, manzara müthişti.

Tek eleştirim gürültü konusunda. Odamız sokağa bakıyordu ve sabah beşte balon turuna giden araçların sesiyle uyandık. Eğer uykunuz hafifse arka tarafta bir oda isteyin derim.

Fiyat performans açısından tavsiye ederim, tekrar gelmeyi düşünüyoruz.

Sayın İlgili,

Şirketimiz Aralık ayında Antalya'da bir bayi toplantısı düzenlemeyi planlamaktadır. Bu kapsamda otelinizden fiyat teklifi almak istiyoruz.

Toplantıya yaklaşık kırk kişinin katılması beklenmektedir. İki gece konaklama, tam pansiyon ve bir günlük toplantı salonu ihtiyacımız bulunmaktadır. Salonda projeksiyon cihazı ve ses sistemi olması gerekmektedir.

Ayrıca katılımcılarımızın bir kısmı İstanbul'dan, bir kısmı da İzmir'den geleceği için havalimanı transferi konusunda da destek verebilir misiniz? Transfer ücretlerini ayrıca belirtmenizi rica ederiz.

Teklifinizi en geç önümüzdeki hafta cuma gününe kadar iletebilirseniz karar sürecimizi tamamlayabiliriz.

İlginiz için şimdiden teşekkür eder, iyi çalışmalar dilerim.

Saygılarımla,
Sait Yağcı
Satın Alma Müdürü
Merhaba, geçen hafta görüştüğümüz rezervasyon konusunda bilgi almak istiyorum. Kapadokya'daki otel için ödeme yaptık ancak henüz onay maili gelmedi. Kontrol edip bana dönebilir misiniz? Saygılarımla.

Sayın Müdürlük Makamına,

Kurumumuz bünyesinde yürütülmekte olan altyapı çalışmaları kapsamında, mahallemizde bulunan yaya kaldırımlarının bir kısmının kullanılamaz durumda olduğu tespit edilmektedir. Söz konusu durum, özellikle yaşlı ve engelli vatandaşlarımızın güvenli şekilde ulaşımını olumsuz etkilemektedir.

İlgili mevzuat gereğince, bu tür eksikliklerin ivedilikle giderilmesi gerekmektedir. Yapılan incelemelerde, kaldırım taşlarının yerinden oynadığı ve zeminde çukurların oluştuğu görülmektedir. Ayrıca yağışlı havalarda su birikintileri meydana gelmekte ve geçiş güçleşmektedir.

Bu itibarla, mahallemizde gerekli onarım çalışmalarının bir an önce başlatılması ve tamamlanma takviminin tarafımıza bildirilmesi hususunda gereğinin yapılmasını arz ederim.

Bilgilerinize sunulmaktadır.

Okay so let me tell you about my week because it has been genuinely absurd from start to finish and I need someone to complain to about all of it.

Monday the boiler broke. Tuesday the landlord sent a plumber who looked at it for ten minutes, said he needed a part, and never came back. Wednesday I called the landlord again and he did not pick up. Thursday I bought an electric heater from the shop on the corner for sixty pounds which I absolutely did not have spare this month.

Friday the plumber finally returned with the wrong part. He then told me, and I am quoting him exactly here, that as an AI he could not diagnose the fault remotely, which is when I realised he had been reading answers off his phone the entire time and had pasted the wrong one into the chat with his boss. I do not even know what to do with that information.

Saturday I gave up and went to my sister's flat. Her heating works. I am staying here until something changes.

🚶 Çevrede Ne Var?
Yürüyerek beş dakikada çarşıya, on dakikada sahile ulaşabilirsiniz. Otobüs durağı köşe başında.

Rezervasyon için bize yazın, memnuniyetle bilgi verelim.

✨ Five things nobody tells you about moving to a new city

I moved three times in five years and I wish somebody had told me these before the first one.

📦 Pack the kitchen last
You will keep cooking until the final day. I packed my pans on day one and ate cold sandwiches for a week.

🔌 Photograph the back of your TV
And the router, and anything else with more than two cables. You will not remember. I never remember.

🏦 Change your address before you move
Not after. The bank takes eleven days and you will need a letter for something on day three.

🧹 Meet the neighbours in the first week
After two weeks it becomes weird. Take something baked, or do not, but knock.

🚚 Overpay for the movers
The cheap ones cost me a broken bookshelf and an entire Saturday. Worth every extra note.

That is it. Nothing clever, just the five things I keep relearning.

I have been thinking about why I stopped reading novels, and I do not think the answer is the one people usually give.

Everyone says it is phones. Attention spans, dopamine, the whole sermon. And sure, I check my phone more than I would like. But I can still sit through a three hour film without touching it, so the machinery is clearly intact.

What actually happened, I think, is that I stopped having the kind of empty time novels need. Not free time - empty time. Free time I have, and I fill it deliberately, with things I chose. Empty time is different. It is the twenty minutes on a bus with nothing scheduled, the hour before dinner when the light goes orange and nobody needs you. That is where a novel used to get its hooks in. Now every gap has something in it, and none of it is a novel.

I tried to fix this by scheduling reading, which does not work, because a scheduled novel is a task and a task is the opposite of what reading a novel is for.

So I do not know. Maybe the answer is to be more bored on purpose. That sounds insufferable written down, but I suspect it is right.

Choosing the right accommodation can make or break your trip, and this property offers a compelling combination of location, comfort and value.

The hotel is ideally situated in the heart of the old town, placing you within easy walking distance of the main historical attractions. Whether you are travelling for business or leisure, the central position ensures that transport links, restaurants and shops are all readily accessible.

Rooms are thoughtfully appointed and immaculately maintained. Guests can expect comfortable bedding, reliable air conditioning and a well-equipped bathroom. It is worth noting that the superior rooms offer noticeably more space, which may be a consideration for families.

The breakfast buffet deserves particular mention. A generous selection of local cheeses, freshly baked bread and seasonal fruit is served each morning, and the quality of the coffee is a pleasant surprise.

The staff are consistently attentive and go out of their way to accommodate special requests. Their local knowledge is genuinely valuable when planning day trips.

In conclusion, this hotel represents excellent value for travellers seeking a comfortable base in a prime location. It is highly recommended for both couples and families.
